title: Crystal Crop Protection IPO Details
intro:
Crystal Crop Protection IPO is a book build issue of ₹455.49 crores. The issue is a combination of fresh issue of 1.31 crore shares aggregating to ₹354.77 crores and offer for sale of 37.03 lakh shares aggregating to ₹100.71 crores.

Crystal Crop Protection IPO opens for subscription on Nov 18, 2026 and closes on Nov 20, 2026. The allotment for the Crystal Crop Protection IPO is expected to be finalized on Nov 23, 2026. Crystal Crop Protection IPO will list on NSE and BSE with a tentative listing date fixed as Nov 26, 2026.

Crystal Crop Protection IPO is set issue price band at ₹259 to ₹272 per share. The lot size for an application is 55 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹14,960 (55 shares) (based on upper price).

IIFL Capital Services Ltd. is the book running lead manager and MUFG Intime India Pvt.Ltd. is the registrar of the issue.

Refer to Crystal Crop Protection IPO RHP for detailed Information.

paragraphs: Incorporated in 1994, Crystal Crop Protection is a crop solutions company with agrochemicals and seeds as its core offerings. Its portfolio includes crop protection products such as herbicides, fungicides and insecticides, along with natural crop solutions like bio-stimulants, bio-protectants, plant growth regulators, liquid fertilizers and micronutrients. It also offer seeds for field crops, vegetable crops and flowers. The offerings are customized for Indian farmers through research and development (“R&D”) including by collaborations with various multinational companies, delivering relevant solutions that aim to enhance farm economics, yield, productivity and profitability.

Its products are designed specifically for Indian farmers and are supported by strong in-house research and development, as well as collaborations with multinational companies. The company follows a fully integrated business model that combines R&D, seed breeding, backward-integrated and technology-enabled manufacturing, and a pan-India distribution network, with a strong focus on farmers’ needs.

As of June 30, 2026, The company hold 63 PVP registrations granted in cotton, pearl millet, sorghum and mustard and maintain a strong run-rate of new product launches with an innovation index of 24.62%. They have a portfolio of over 275 hybrid seeds, comprising 111 field crop varieties, 139 vegetable seed varieties and 25 marigold seed varieties.

As of June 30, 2026, we have a pan-India distribution network across 23 states and four union territories with an aggregate of 14,717 independent distributors, across business segments and brands. The business has a strong pan-India network of over 13,000 distributors and 36 distribution centers.
strengths: Strong R&D capabilities backed by advanced technology infrastructure and collaborations
A deep connect with Indian farmers resulting in strong brand equity
Operational excellence with focus on our multi-pronged go-to-market strategy
Vertically integrated manufacturing operations backed by robust R&D capabilities and strong supply chain
Strategic acquisitions and successful integration of growth opportunities
Diversification across business verticals, geographies, product categories and crops

faqs.question: How to apply in Crystal Crop Protection IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply for the Crystal Crop Protection IPO online through the Kite platform under the IPO & Bids section using UPI as the payment method. Steps to Apply for Crystal Crop Protection IPO through Zerodha Log in to your Zerodha Kite account. On the home page, click IPO & Bids in the top menu. Select the IPO tab and find the Crystal Crop Protection IPO in the list. Click Apply next to the IPO. Enter your UPI ID, bid quantity, and bid price. Submit the IPO application. Open your UPI app and approve the mandate to complete the application process. For more details, visit the Zerodha IPO Application Process Review .
